mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above the 10-year average level signal robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds the 10-year average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 215, monetary tightening in an inflationary environment compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5 and CPIAUCSL > 215.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (industrial production below 110), manufacturing weakness signals economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth above the 5-year average (130,000 thousand persons) indicates strong labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales below 380,000 million dollars indicate weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 380000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and robust industrial production (INDPRO > 110) together signal broad-based economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1000 and INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 2.0), the Federal Reserve's rate cuts stimulate equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0.
